jobs.title: Project Manager III
jobs.description:
Qlarant is a not-for-profit corporation that partners with public and private sectors to create high quality, safe, and efficient delivery of health care and human services programs. We have multiple lines of business including population health, utilization review, managed care organization quality review, and quality assurance for programs serving individuals with developmental disabilities. Qlarant is also a national leader in fighting fraud, waste and abuse for large organizations across the country. In addition, our Foundation provides grant opportunities to those with programs for underserved communities.

**Best People, Best Solutions, Best Results**

**Job Summary:**

Leads and oversees complex projects, ensuring that all project goals are met within prescribed timeframes and budgetary constraints. This role provides strategic direction for project execution, optimizes resource allocation, and enhances project management processes. The Project Manager III is responsible for aligning projects with organizational objectives, mentoring team members, and driving project performance to meet customer and contractual requirements.

**Essential Functions:**

* Leads and directs the planning and execution of high-priority projects, setting strategic goals, defining project scope, and ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and customer needs.
* Assesses project proposals to determine feasibility, resource requirements, and potential risks, making strategic decisions on project prioritization and resource allocation.
* Develops and implements advanced project management processes and tools, integrating best practices to enhance project execution and drive consistent performance improvements.
* Monitors and controls project budgets, timelines, and quality metrics, making adjustments as necessary to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
* Confers with senior management and stakeholders to provide project updates, forecast project needs, and align project goals with broader business strategies.
* Improves team performance through coaching and mentoring, guiding project team members to enhance their skills, adhere to project timelines, and achieve project objectives.
* Establishes governance frameworks to ensure compliance with industry standards, contractual obligations, and quality assurance processes across all phases of project delivery.
* Identifies and mitigates risks proactively, implementing strategies to address potential project obstacles and ensure the continuity of project execution.
* Regulates project reporting and performance analysis, ensuring that project data is accurate, relevant, and supports decision-making at all levels of the organization.
* Monitors and manages private investigations licensing actions, including understanding state specific requirements and individual investigator licensing requirements

**Level of Supervision Received:**  
Plans and arranges own work; works with manager to prioritize projects

**Education (can be substituted for experience):**  
Minimum Bachelor's Degree required

**Work Experience (can be substituted for education):**  
5 - 7 years of experience required; 8 - 11 years preferred

**Certification(s):**  
Preferred certifications: active and current Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), Certified Professional in Healthcare Management (CPHM), Certified Case Manager (CCM), Registered Nurse (RN), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), and/or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE)

Qlarant is an Equal Opportunity Employer of Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities.

Qlarant is a drug-free workplace. All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of pre-employment background and drug screens.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 12/04/2026MEET THE TEAM
  
Our Readiness team helps our field teams build the skills they need to thrive in an AI-powered world. We work directly with business leaders to find where our teams need support, translate those needs into clear learning plans, and build programs that actually help our people sell better. We focus on getting things done so our teams can focus on what matters most!
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
  
As a Program Manager, you’ll be the person who connects our business goals to the skills our team needs to hit their targets. You will spend your time identifying where we have gaps in technical or process knowledge and building the paths to close them. You’ll be the bridge between Sales and CX, making sure our teams have the tools and training to win. We need someone who can see how AI and new tech will shift our needs and help us adapt in real-time. You’ll be responsible for your projects from planning to delivery, keeping stakeholders in the loop and taking full responsibility for the results!
  
In this role, we map out what the field needs today and turn those priorities into clear plans. We build role-based learning paths that move our teams from basic awareness to real-world technical expertise. By bringing Sales and CX together, we ensure our training aligns with the customer journey, keeping things simple and free of duplicate work. We use data to make sure our training is actually moving the needle on performance, and we always look for ways that AI can improve our workflows!
  
  
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with at least 8 years of experience in program management, technical enablement, or learning and development.
* 5+ years of experience running complex, cross-functional projects from start to finish, along with a track record of identifying skills gaps and building the roadmaps to fix them.
* Experience working with Sales or Customer Experience teams in a large, global company, plus a solid grasp of networking, security, or software so you can partner effectively with our technical and architecture experts!

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Background in organizational change or technical readiness within a global team.
* Experience designing certification frameworks for customer-facing roles or using AI to automate workflows and boost productivity.
* Build strong relationships easily and can influence others without needing formal authority.
* Ability to take complex information and turn it into clear, actionable updates for our senior leaders!

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with strong communication and organizational skills, an understanding of project management fundamentals, and an eagerness to learn and grow in a collaborative environment. If you enjoy coordinating projects, solving problems, and building relationships, we encourage you to apply.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Wellness programs and Employee Assistance Program

* Familiarity with clinical trials, regulated environments, software development, or translation processes is beneficial but not required.
* Ability to work remotely within the United States and maintain Eastern Time Zone business hours.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Override
jobs.description:
Fortreum is a trusted leader in cloud and cybersecurity services, ranked among the Top 5 FedRAMP Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO). With the addition of Kovr.AI, we have expanded our capabilities to include advanced cyber risk quantification and analytics, enabling organizations to better understand, measure, and communicate risk. Together, we deliver independent, third-party, vendor-agnostic regulatory assessment and advisory services, alongside advanced cybersecurity offensive and compliance technical solutions. Our comprehensive service portfolio spans regulatory compliance frameworks including FedRAMP, CMMC, FISMA, SOC, PCI, ISO, and HIPAA.

Working with Fortune 500 companies and leading cloud service providers, we’ve built our reputation on service-delivery excellence and an unwavering commitment to client success. Our continued rapid growth creates exceptional opportunities for driven professionals to make their mark in the cybersecurity industry—guided by our core values: quality above all, a customer-driven mindset, autonomy, and personal accountability.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Supporting Fortreum’s Override team, you will work alongside skilled offensive security professionals who test the defenses of cloud service providers, federal contractors, and technology companies. In this fast-paced role, you will manage multiple penetration testing engagements at once, moving quickly between clients, testers, and deadlines while delivering a high-touch, white glove experience. You will keep scoping, scheduling, client coordination, and reporting on track so our testers can focus on the work they do best.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and maintain project plans for penetration testing engagements, including preparing pre-assessment documentation and templates such as Requests for Information (RFIs), kickoff presentations, Rules of Engagement (ROE), testing schedules, milestones, deliverables and assigned responsibilities.
* Prepare and obtain signatures on rules of engagement, authorization letters, and other required planning documentation before testing begins
* Schedule and lead client kickoff meetings, confirming scope, testing windows, points of contact, and communication and escalation procedures
* Coordinate testing logistics with clients, such as test accounts, network access, allow listing, and notification of their security operations teams
* Monitor and manage assessment scope to identify scope discrepancies and potential scope creep, coordinating with technical leads, clients, and the Program Manager to evaluate impacts, address changes, and ensure appropriate approvals are obtained.
* Manage communication of critical findings during testing according to agreed escalation procedures
* Provide responsive, white glove service to clients as primary point of contact, anticipating their needs and keeping them informed at every stage of the engagement
* Execute high velocity context switching by pivoting rapidly between engagements in different phases (scoping, active testing, reporting, retesting) without losing track of details or commitments
* Reprioritize work as testing windows, client availability, and findings change, keeping stakeholders informed of any impact
* Collaborate with other Project Managers to coordinate tester assignments across concurrent engagements, ensure balanced workloads, and work with the Program Manager to identify and resolve scheduling conflicts as needed.
* Track report development and quality review cycles to ensure reports are delivered on time
* Monitor progress to ensure delivery within allocated hours, and assist team leads in validating budgets within financial management tools
* Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, and schedule concerns to leadership as needed
* Maintain accurate project data in project management tools (for example, Jira)
* Complete engagement closeout, ensuring all deliverables and documentation are finalized and client data is handled according to policy
* This is a client-facing role requiring strong communication and organizational skills. Limited travel may be required.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or 4 years of equivalent experience
* 2 to 6+ years of experience managing multiple concurrent projects with internal teams and external clients, maintaining quality across parallel timelines
* 2+ years of experience in information security, SaaS, or professional services
* Experience supporting multiple penetration testing engagement types, such as network, web application, cloud, and social engineering testing
* Understanding of penetration testing concepts and engagement types, such as network, web application, cloud, and social engineering testing, and the ability to discuss scope and findings with clients and testers
* Ability to switch between tasks and engagements quickly while staying focused and accurate
* Ability to manage competing priorities with flexibility and sound judgment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a client-first approach to service
* Skills in budget management, estimation, capacity planning, facilitation, and presentation
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and project management tools (for example, Jira)
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced team environment

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience supporting FedRAMP penetration testing, readiness, authorization, or continuous monitoring efforts
* Familiarity with security documentation such as SSPs, POA&Ms, and control implementation narratives
* PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification

Securitas Technology, part of Securitas, is a world-leading provider of integrated security solutions that protect, connect, and optimize businesses of all types and sizes. More than 13,000 colleagues in 40 countries are focused daily on our purpose to help make your world a safer place and our commitment to deliver an unparalleled client experience. With clients at the heart of all we do, our people, knowledge, and technology power our connected ecosystem of health, safety and security solutions and services.

As a Program Manager you will manage programs for Fortune 1000, national accounts, and enterprise customers. This position will support functions at the customer service level for all Electronic Security project opportunities. National Accounts are typically multi-geography enterprises and require ongoing coordination across area boundaries representing $15-$50 million total annual potential service and sales revenue to Securitas Electronic Security.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide support to National/Key account (as assigned) managing overall service/implementation account performance, technical problem identification and resolution, and general customer service and satisfaction.
* Organize and lead regular face to face visits with assigned Program teams to discuss performance, projects, issues, and plans.
* Using internal systems, and interaction with field operations, assure appropriate resources are applied and scheduled
* Interfaces daily with Management in Sales, Service, and Headquarter Field Support.
* Electronic Security Group to discuss future ESP growth and how we can assist and plan for future support
* Review workload regularly to ensure team is right sized, plan resource requirements for future opportunities identified by the Account teams.
* Directly contact / interface with customers when required.
* Influence process excellence team to assist in delivery process development and revisions to meet current business environment.
* Create strategy and update project best practices/ processes and support procedures/requirements.
* Provide support in achieving account profitability goals
* Provide support of Installation Managers and Directors efforts in customer service relationship management involving National Account customer base with prompt, efficient, effective, and quality customer service and installation support through multiple service branches and/or multiple service areas
* Provide and assist Installation Managers and Directors in providing necessary reporting, problem resolution, action plans and resource attainment to resolve performance issues.
* Forms and maintains databases where necessary of nationally provided commodities.
* Monitor Performance and provide direction to ensure projects are on time, on budget and within scope unless out of scope issues identified.
* Create and maintain reporting dashboard to client, and present project, service and initiative conditions, weekly and monthly as well as regular business reviews, Quarterly/Annually.
* Interface and coordinate with Logistics as it relates to staging and / or kitting ESP orders for quality installation readiness regarding spoke orders.
* Meet on a regular basis to develop project plan with customer, including schedule, specific responsibilities of each party, deliverables, terms of acceptance, etc.
* Ensures that the project team is trained on policy, standards, and procedures and those they are practiced in everyday project activities.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Electronic Security Integration Experience
* 10 years Project Management experience in security integration or a related field
* Proficiency with MS Outlook, Word, and Excel
* Understanding of construction processes and project flows in construction
* Past experience in delivering professional services such as consulting, system implementation, software support, network design or installation, etc.
* Demonstrated record of team management skills
* Successfully managed National Accounts
* Excellent verbal and written customer communication skills.
* Strong technical skills and understanding of technology such as software, networking, and systems development.
* Very detailed and organized

**Education/Experience:**

* HS Diploma/GED required.
* College degree in business or related field preferred.
* Previous experience and familiarity with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within purchasing field preferred.

**Securitas Technology Offers Comprehensive Benefits Including**

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Coverage
* Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability
* 401K with 60% Match up to 6% of salary
* Paid vacation, holiday, and sick time
* Educational Assistance
* Exceptional growth opportunities

We are a nationwide provider of security solutions and an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. Our core values of Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness are proudly demonstrated daily by our employees to our customers and the communities we service.

jobs.title: C-21 CLS Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

**Work Where it Matters**

Akima Logistics Services (ALS), an Akima company, is not just another federal logistics contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At ALS, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

**For our shareholders,** ALS provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

**For our government customers,** ALS delivers aviation logistics and supply chain services to the Department of Defense and federal civilian government.

**As an ALS employee,** you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

Description:

The C-21 Program Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and strategic direction of a ~$30M annual aviation maintenance and operations program spanning both CONUS and OCONUS locations. This role ensures compliance with contractual requirements, regulatory standards, financial targets, and customer expectations while leading multi‑site teams and maintaining operational readiness across all supported locations.

Responsibilities:

* Program Leadership & Oversight:
  + Provide overall program leadership, direction, and decision-making for multi‑site aviation operations.
  + Ensure all activities meet contractual requirements, schedules, and performance standards.
  + Maintain strong relationships with government customers, including Contracting Officers, CORs, Program Office leadership, and base-level stakeholders.
  + Conduct regular site visits (CONUS and OCONUS) to monitor performance, support local leadership, and ensure program consistency.
* Financial Management:
  + Oversee full program financials for a ~$30M annual contract.
  + Manage budgets, forecasts, burn rates, funding levels, and cost controls.
  + Ensure accurate reporting, invoicing, and financial compliance.
  + Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising safety or mission readiness.
* Contract Compliance & Administration:
  + Ensure adherence to all contractual obligations, including performance metrics, reporting requirements, and deliverables.
  + Lead contract modifications, RFPs, technical proposals, and pricing actions.
  + Serve as the primary interface for contract issues, ensuring timely resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Operational Management:
  + Oversee aircraft maintenance, logistics, supply chain performance, and operational readiness across all supported sites.
  + Ensure consistent implementation of processes, procedures, and maintenance standards.
  + Support site managers and maintenance leadership to resolve operational challenges and improve efficiency.
  + Plan, coordinate, and oversee depot-level maintenance events, major inspections, structural repair programs, and aircraft modifications.
  + Manage all offsite aircraft maintenance activities, avionics upgrades, paint and corrosion control events, and specialized repair activities.
* Quality & Safety:
  + Ensure compliance with USAF and company standards for safety and quality.
  + Oversee quality assurance programs, audits, and corrective action plans.
  + Promote a culture of safety across all locations; ensure timely reporting and resolution of safety incidents.
  + Support REDs and ensure professionally written submissions to the customer.
* Team Leadership & Development:
  + Lead and support site managers, maintenance leads, quality managers, and administrative staff across multiple locations.
  + Hire, train, coach, and evaluate personnel to ensure high-performing teams.
  + Promote documentation culture: performance, behavior, training, and corrective actions.
  + Support leadership development for managers seeking upward mobility (e.g., into QM or PM roles).
* Stakeholder Engagement:
  + Attend PMRs, Ops meetings, site briefs, and customer forums.
  + Communicate program status, performance, and risks to corporate leadership.
  + Develop solutions to customer challenges and implement process improvements across all locations.
* Travel Requirements:
  + Regular travel required to CONUS and OCONUS sites.
  + Flexibility to support emergent site needs or customer meetings.

Qualifications:

* 10 + years operations management in aviation environment.
* Strong financial management skills (budgeting, forecasting, cost control).
* Experience working with USAF, DoD, or similar organizations.
* Strong understanding of aircraft maintenance, quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to travel to CONUS and OCONUS locations.
* Must have a SECRET clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Prior experience managing contracts valued at $20M+.
* Knowledge of FAR/DFARS, government contracting, and aviation logistics.
* Experience with aircraft modification programs, RED process, and quality systems.
* PMP or equivalent program management certification.

jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW**

**About the Role**

Andrew Reise Consulting is a leading customer experience consulting firm helping Fortune 500 clients design and realize measurable business value through CX strategy, contact center optimization, and technology deployment. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead high-touch, outcome-focused delivery engagements for our most complex enterprise accounts.

  

In this role, you are the operational hub for multi-workstream enterprise engagements. You own contractual delivery, manage escalations, drive cross-functional coordination, and serve as the primary operational contact for strategic clients across financial services, healthcare, and telecom. You work alongside Engagement Directors, Customer Success Managers, and Account Executives — and you are accountable for making the program run.

  

The right candidate is a self-directed operator who thrives in complex, matrixed environments, keeps projects moving without waiting to be told what to do next, and builds trust with senior client stakeholders through clarity, follow-through, and proactive communication.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**What You'll Own**

**Operational Leadership & Program Execution**

* Own end-to-end execution of all contractual delivery activities within the program scope

* Drive progress across all parallel project workstreams — implementation, onboarding, adoption, and support

* Manage all assigned project resources and ensure cross-team alignment across delivery, support, and product functions

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for client questions, special requests, and escalations

* Proactively communicate account-specific status, risks, and decisions to client and internal stakeholders

  

* **Program Governance & Artifact Ownership**

This role is the operational backbone of the program governance model. The Program Manager is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and applying a consistent set of governance practices and artifacts across all client accounts.

  

* Establish and maintain a program-level RAID log (Risks, Actions, Issues, Decisions); ensure issues and risks are escalated to the appropriate leader or team and documented consistently

* Own and maintain a defined set of program artifacts for each account: RACI/RASCI, program calendar, RAID log, communications plan, dependency chart, project scorecards, and program summary

* Collect project-level status from individual project managers and roll up into program-level status reporting and scorecards

* Ensure all program artifacts and deliverables are stored and maintained in an accessible, consistent manner — preferably via SharePoint/Teams

* Maintain a centralized account-level decision log as part of the RAID to capture all program-level decisions and approvals

* Apply consistent governance practices across all assigned accounts; templates and approaches should be uniform across the portfolio

  

* **Cross-Project Dependency & Schedule Management**

* Identify and manage cross-workstream dependencies; maintain a program-level dependency chart to proactively surface sequencing risks before they impact delivery

* Maintain a program calendar to track and communicate key events, milestones, and coordination points across all active workstreams and client accounts

* Ensure cross-project coordination of potential impacts and dependencies; align project teams on sequencing, shared resources, and interdependencies

* Own work planning and timeline management at the program level; ensure project schedules are maintained by project managers at the appropriate level of detail for communication

  

**Escalation & Risk Management**

* Serve as the first escalation point for client concerns, critical support issues, and delivery risks

* Oversee escalation resolution in coordination with account managers and internal leadership

* Identify and surface risks early — before they become client-visible problems

* Develop mitigation plans and drive resolution with a bias toward action

* Monitor project budgets and burn rates; raise financial risks proactively and support change order processes in coordination with project managers and account leadership

  

**Stakeholder Communication & Governance**

* Manage all internal and external meeting coordination, agendas, and follow-through across the full program cadence (weekly touchpoints, service reviews, business reviews, and annual strategic reviews)

* Produce clear, concise status reporting tailored to operational and executive audiences — including program summaries and project scorecards

* Maintain a program-level communications plan and roster to ensure appropriate communication levels, avoid conflicts, and prevent under- or over-communication

* Partner with internal leadership and stakeholders to ensure client and internal teams are aligned on priorities, milestones, and value realization

* Articulate findings, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders with confidence and credibility

  

**Value Realization & Client Success**

* Keep delivery anchored to client outcomes by connecting program execution to the client's defined KPIs and success metrics

* Monitor performance across workstreams and flag deviations from plan before they impact value realization timelines

* Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders to translate delivery status into a client-facing value narrative

* Support business development and expansion by identifying opportunities to deepen the client partnership

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 7+ years of program or project management experience in a consulting, SaaS delivery, or professional services environment

* Demonstrated experience managing multi-workstream programs with enterprise clients — implementation, onboarding, or ongoing managed service delivery

* Proven track record of operating as a self-directed lead: setting your own agenda, identify

Through our select network of Medicare and Medicaid Certified and Accredited providers, we are available 24/7 to meet the needs of our patients with compassion, expertise, and excellence.

For more than 30 years, we have been dedicated to improving lives by delivering the highest quality in-home care services. As a trusted market leader in value-based Home Health, Durable Medical Equipment, and Home Infusion Services, we proudly serve more than 2 million lives across the United States and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. Our integrated care model is trusted by leading Managed Care Organizations (MCOs), physicians, and healthcare partners because of our commitment to exceptional patient outcomes and coordinated care.

At IHCS, our patients are at the heart of everything we do. We believe in creating a culture built on compassion, integrity, collaboration, and innovation. Every team member plays a vital role in fulfilling our mission of enhancing the quality of life for those we serve through Exceptional Customer Service, Proven Outcomes, and Seamless Care.

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are committed to excellence, we invite you to join our growing team. Together, we can continue transforming home healthcare while making a difference in the lives of our patients and the communities we serve.

**Join IHCS where our patients are #1, and our people make the difference. Apply today!**

* 17 days of PTO

jobs.title: Commercial Program Manager
jobs.description:
At IEM, we're not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we're shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what's possible. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting out, you'll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world's most dynamic markets.

**Location:** Fremont, CA

**Reports To:** Director Global Accounts Executive

**Salary Range:** $132,000-$200,000

**Position Summary:**

We are a rapidly expanding manufacturing company focused on delivering complex, high-volume solutions for leading enterprise customers. Our success is built on operational excellence, strategic partnerships, and an unwavering commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction. We are seeking a professional, proactive, and strategic **Commercial Program Manager** to lead and manage the partnership with one of our most critical enterprise customers.

The **Commercial Program Manager** is responsible for managing the full program lifecycle, ensuring alignment between customer demand and internal production capabilities. This role is accountable for aligning internal operations with client requirements, ensuring timely delivery, quality performance, and seamless execution across all phases of the program. The ideal candidate is a proactive, strategic thinker with strong program management experience and the ability to coordinate across diverse internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Proactively review and interpret customer forecasts to identify trends, anticipate demand shifts, and align supplier capacity and internal production schedules accordingly.
* Translate forecast data into actionable plans by working directly with production teams to coordinate build output and ensure readiness for deployment.
* Own the process for correcting purchase orders, reconciling discrepancies, and coordinating timely pricing updates between internal teams and the customer
* Respond quickly to quality and field service issues, coordinating internally to drive resolutions and minimize customer impact.
* Actively contribute to customer related projects and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Ensure program delivery aligns with customer service level agreements by constantly monitoring performance metrics and taking corrective action as needed.
* Take a data-driven approach to aligning inventory with forecasted demand and support planning for body of design, product phaseouts, and lifecycle transitions.
* Analyze volume trends and program data to inform decision-making, highlight risks, and support continuous improvement in delivery performance.
* Monitor inventory levels closely, perform flow analysis, and take corrective actions to prevent shortages or excess while maintaining alignment with customer demand.
* Foster a culture of team accountability and collaborative problem-solving across departments by setting clear expectations, following up on deliverables, and driving shared program goals forward.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering or related field (MBA or PMP certification a plus).
* 5+ years of program or project management experience in a manufacturing or enterprise client-facing role with annualized volume exceeding $10 million.
* Proven track record managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders across technical and business functions.
* Strong understanding of supply chain processes, inventory management, and demand planning.
* Experience with ERP and customer portal tools.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and drive results across functional boundaries.
* Comfortable managing ambiguity and adapting to a dynamic, high-growth environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with a collaborative, team-first mentality.

**Why Join IEM**

At IEM, you'll join a team that powers some of the world's most ambitious projects. We're engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you're driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: SRE Project Manager (SPM)**

**Location: Remote**

The SRE Project Manager (SPM) is a strategic and execution-oriented leader responsible for driving alignment, visibility, and delivery across multiple SRE engineering teams. This role blends technical program management with agile execution oversight—focusing on infrastructure projects, incident and RCA management, cloud cost optimization, observability tooling, and ongoing platform reliability efforts.

SPMs serve as force multipliers for their teams, removing blockers, ensuring clarity of priorities, and enabling engineers to focus on high-impact work. They translate high-level business goals into organized, measurable, and achievable initiatives while upholding high standards of communication, documentation, and follow-through.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead project planning, backlog refinement, sprint execution, and post-mortem ceremonies for one or more SRE teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional alignment with Dev, Security, and Cloud Engineering partners for work like containerization, version upgrades, and AWS infrastructure changes.
* Proactively manage Jira hygiene and workflows—ensuring that tickets are well-defined, estimated, assigned, and properly linked to Epics, Themes, and organizational priorities.
* Track and report progress on reliability, performance, and cost-focused initiatives using dashboards, Confluence documentation, and recurring status updates.
* Facilitate regular team ceremonies and leadership reviews, keeping meetings focused, data-driven, and outcome-oriented.
* Support compliance, access control, and decommissioning efforts across cloud and on-prem systems.
* Identify patterns and areas of opportunity for automation, documentation, and tooling improvements.
* Act as a steward of engineering time—minimizing context-switching, streamlining workflows, and closing the loop on stale or duplicative work.
* Contribute to shared documentation and knowledge management across the program.
* Continuously improve team processes through retrospectives and experimentation.

**Qualifications**

* Available to work 9am-5pm, US Eastern Time.
* 4+ years of experience in technical program management, project management, or product ownership roles in software engineering/development teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum principles and Jira/Confluence best practices (e.g., Dashboards, JQL, Macros).
* Familiarity with cloud-native technologies (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes, ECS, Terraform).
* Experience with observability, alerting, and incident response tooling (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, PagerDuty).
* Comfortable analyzing data to drive decisions and communicating findings clearly to both engineers and executives.
* High attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.
* Empathy and communication skills to work with diverse, distributed engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualities**

* Ability to manage ambiguity and bring structure to complex or undefined problem spaces.
* Systems thinker who can connect day-to-day tasks to larger program and business objectives.
* Collaborative mindset with a passion for empowering engineers and reducing toil.
* Familiarity with cost optimization strategies in cloud infrastructure.
* Previous exposure to infrastructure, SRE, and DevOps concepts.

**Themesoft Inc** is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.

The Senior Program Manager act as the customer focal point for coordination of system implementations, including, but not limited to the following: project planning, project management, business analysis and design. The program manager must be able to effectively evaluate project and delivery processes across a broad scope of projects with differing technical solutions and implement improvements. A program manager must be a self-starter and work with minimal direction.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Manage the overall delivery relationship with assigned program / project clients.
* Frequent and direct contact with senior level managers, directors and executives to provide technical expertise and project status.
* Lead overall implementation of large programs / projects, with team sizes varying from 3 to 50 people [TTEC Digital staff, contractors, client resources and vendors].
* Set up and drive program management functions including a communication plan, meetings, tracking, reporting, escalation processes, functional documentation, and other internal processes.
* Deliver weekly status reports, either developed directly or in concert with project managers working in the program, and providing program / project progress and issues to client stakeholders, delivery management and account team.
* Ensure client stakeholder alignment and drive overall program customer satisfaction.
* Develop and deliver financial reporting dashboards providing project financial status to client stakeholders.
* Identify high-level risks, assumptions, and constraints. Implement approved actions and workarounds to minimize the impact of risks on the project/program, including delivery of change management required to address approved actions.
* Review program / project invoices for accuracy.
* Work with program / project staff to develop work plans and assign duties, responsibilities to ensure the specified program / project objectives are met.
* Coach members of the project teams as needed to optimize the efficiency of the team
* Manage the program resource plan, project plan and schedule.
* Achieve program / project goals within designated constraints.
* Perform and support project management duties related to resource utilization and revenue projection.
* Assist in the continuous improvement to the established project management methodologies
* Perform related duties as assigned

### **What You'll Bring to the Role**

Experience delivering transformation projects.  
Deep knowledge with modern CCaaS solutions and related technology, NiCE preferred.  
15+ years Project/Program Management experience within a consulting / professional services environment.5-8 years strategic development experience with evidence of significant client impact; strong relationships, influence over direct and value creation.  
Experience leading a enterprise-level client programs with multiple projects and workstreams, including waterfall, agile/scrum and hybrid methodology run projects.  
Experience leading multiple teams ranging in size from 3 to 50 people  
Hands on experience producing functional and or technical design deliverables defined by formal structure methodology

We are looking for a confident leader who thrives in dynamic environments, embraces change, and enjoys solving complex problems. jobs.title: Information Security Manager
jobs.description:
**Information Security Manager**

**Department:** Information Technology / Security

**Reports to:** VP of IT or Director of Information Security

**Location:** Remote

**Employment type:** Full-time

**Position Summary**
====================

The Information Security Manager leads the organization's security operations and risk program. The role oversees security monitoring and incident response, manages the SOC and its vendors, reports on security posture to executive leadership, and ensures the organization meets its compliance and audit obligations. It combines hands-on operational oversight with governance and communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Security Monitoring and Incident Response**
---------------------------------------------

* Oversee 24/7 security monitoring and threat detection, and review, validate, and prioritize alerts from the managed SOC, SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, email, and network security tools.
* Act as the internal escalation point for security incidents, including phishing, malware, account compromise, data exposure, and policy violations.
* Lead incident response from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
* Coordinate remediation with IT Operations, Helpdesk, M365 and network teams, legal, HR, communications, and third-party vendors.
* Maintain detailed incident documentation, timelines, and post-incident summaries.
* Maintain and test incident response plans, runbooks, and tabletop exercises.

**SOC and Vendor Management**
-----------------------------

* Manage the internal or outsourced SOC, including MSSP and MDR providers, and serve as the primary technical point of contact for the managed SOC/MDR provider.
* Validate SOC findings, challenge false positives, and ensure alerts are actionable and risk-based.
* Participate in tuning discussions to improve alert quality and reduce noise.
* Define, monitor, and enforce vendor SLAs, ensuring incidents meet defined response expectations.
* Evaluate and select security vendors and tools, and manage contracts, renewals, and budgets.
* Conduct regular vendor reviews and escalate performance issues.

**Reporting and Executive Communication**
-----------------------------------------

* Produce recurring security reports for the VP of IT, executive leadership, and board members, including incident summaries, threat trends and metrics, and risk posture and exposure overview.
* Translate technical security data into clear, non-technical business risk language to support decision-making and budget requests.
* Provide ad-hoc briefings following significant incidents or emerging threats.

**Risk, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement**
------------------------------------------------

* Run risk assessments and maintain the risk register and remediation tracking.
* Ensure alignment with applicable frameworks and regulations (e.g., HIPAA, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, as relevant), including providing operational evidence, incident data, and security metrics to support compliance efforts.
* Develop and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, and runbooks.
* Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and opportunities to improve detection, response, and remediation processes.
* Partner with IT leadership to improve overall security maturity and drive the security roadmap.
* Lead security awareness and training initiatives.

**Audits**
----------

* Serve as the primary contact for internal, external, and regulatory audits.
* Coordinate evidence collection, control testing, and responses to audit findings.
* Track remediation of audit findings through to closure.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 6-10 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, or incident response, including at least 2 years in a lead or management role.
* Proven experience responding to real-world security incidents and hands-on SOC operations experience.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, LogRhythm), EDR/XDR solutions (e.g., Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike), and email security, identity security, and endpoint tools.
* Experience managing third-party security vendors and service providers.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA, PHI protection, and healthcare security expectations, as well as other security frameworks and compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting audits and managing remediation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-level summaries.
* Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment during security events.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience working with a managed SOC or MDR provider.
* Healthcare or other regulated-industry background (e.g., finance, government).
* Microsoft 365 security experience (Defender, Entra ID, Purview, etc.).
* Experience with vulnerability management platforms and cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Relevant certifications (preferred, not required): CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, GCIA, GCED, GCIH, Security+, SC-200 or similar.
* Master's degree or MBA.

**Core Competencies**
=====================

* Leadership and team development
* Incident ownership and decision-making
* Risk-based thinking
* Clear executive communication
* Calm, methodical response under pressure
* Strong collaboration across IT and leadership teams
* Vendor and budget management
* Strategic thinking and process improvement

**Working Conditions**
======================

* Participation in an on-call rotation for security incidents.
* Occasional travel for audits, vendor meetings, or conferences [if applicable].

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
===============================

jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Office Ally, we've been revolutionizing healthcare administration since our inception. What started as a clearinghouse focused on simplifying insurance claims processing for healthcare providers has grown into a full-suite healthcare technology company. We offer a range of affordable, cloud-based revenue cycle management solutions –from eligibility verification and claims management to revenue recovery and payment processing –that help healthcare organizations of all sizes streamline operations and reduce administrative burdens so they can focus on what matters most: patient care.

In April 2026, Office Ally acquired Jopari Solutions, Inc, a leader in straight-through electronic claims processing for Property & Casualty (P&C), Commercial, and Government healthcare. Jopari brings deep industry expertise and innovative enterprise payment solutions that are transforming how disbursements are handled across the insurance ecosystem. Together, we are expanding our capabilities across the full healthcare transaction lifecycle, connecting claims, payments, and data exchange to deliver a more seamless and efficient experience for providers, payers, and partners.

At the core of our company are four key values that guide our mission and work:

* **Ownership**: We take pride in our responsibilities, driving results and taking accountability for the success of our projects.
* **Empowerment**: We believe in giving our team the autonomy and support to make decisions that lead to innovative solutions.
* **Innovation**: We continuously seek new and better ways to improve healthcare administration, embracing creativity and forward-thinking technology.
* **Transparent Communication**: Open, honest communication is at the heart of our collaborations, internally and with our clients, ensuring alignment and trust.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled Business Analyst with proven experience in payment technology implementations, specifically leveraging EDI standards, to join our Implementation Services team. This role will be responsible for leading payment technology projects, focusing on Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integrations, mapping, and ensuring compliance with X12 protocols. The successful candidate will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver seamless and efficient payment solutions.

**What** **You'll** **Do**

* **Implementations**: Lead and manage the implementation of payment technology solutions using EDI standards, ensuring accurate setup, configuration, and testing.
* **Requirements Gathering**: Collaborate with business users, vendors, and technical teams to gather, document, and translate business requirements into EDI mapping and transaction sets (e.g., 837, 835, 275, and others).
* **Mapping and Documentation**: Develop detailed documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, and EDI mapping guidelines, to support payment integration processes.
* **Business Process Analysis**: Evaluate current payment workflows and identify areas where our products can improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance for customers.
* **Solution Design**: Partner with solution architects, development teams, and vendors to design and implement payment processing solutions based on EDI protocols and business needs.
* **Testing and Validation**: Oversee the creation and execution of test plans to validate EDI implementations, ensuring successful data transmission and alignment with payment processing requirements.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration**: Function as the key point of contact between technical teams, business stakeholders, and external clients to ensure the successful implementation of payment technology projects.
* **Compliance & Risk Management**: Ensure that all EDI transactions adhere to industry standards, regulations, and best practices.
* **Support & Troubleshooting**: Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for EDI payment systems, resolving issues related to transaction failures, incorrect mappings, or discrepancies in payment processing.

**What** **You'll** **Need**

* 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, within medical billing, clearinghouse, or bill review industries.
* In-depth knowledge and experience with EDI X12 standards and transaction sets (e.g., 837, 835, 275, and others).
* Understanding of mapping, testing, and validating EDI transactions related to medical claims billing and payment processing.
* Initiative-taking with a passion for payment technology and EDI advancements.
* Strong understanding of payment systems, payment gateways, and transaction processing.
* Familiarity with payment industry standards and regulations (e.g., PCI DSS, NACHA).
* Proficient in MS Office suite, JIRA, Confluence, SQL, and Salesforce.
* Experience in writing and executing SQL queries.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical writing.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Exceptional customer service skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience interfacing with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
* Background in Property and Casualty, Healthcare, medical billing/remittance, and payment processing.

**Nice to Have**

* Strategic and innovative thinking abilities.
* Familiarity with Agile, SCRUM, or SDLC methodologies.
* CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or equivalent.

**Why** **You'll** **Love Working at Office Ally**

At Office Ally, your work has a direct impact on healthcare providers and their ability to deliver exceptional care. We're driven by a mission to simplify healthcare administration, making it easier for providers to focus on what they do best—helping patients. As an Office Ally employee, you'll be at the heart of our efforts to deliver exceptional service and software solutions to our clients in the healthcare space.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
**Our Mission**

  

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you're blocked.

We're here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we've built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we're going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc's marketplace topower access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from *seeking* to *getting*. We don't want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

#### **Your Impact on our Mission**

As Senior Program Manager, Marketing Operations, you'll build and run the operating system that enables Marketing to focus on the most important work, make decisions quickly, and execute effectively across teams.

You'll create visibility across Marketing's material commitments, integrated campaigns, dependencies, and capacity tradeoffs. You'll facilitate the planning and prioritization rhythms that help teams align on what matters most, who owns the work, what decisions are needed, and where tradeoffs must be made.

This is a role for a highly organized, strategic, and pragmatic operator who understands how marketing works. You'll work across all Marketing teams and many cross-functional partners throughout the Zocdoc organization. You'll bring structure to complex work without adding unnecessary process, and help teams move from discussion to clear decisions and action. You'll also help Marketing improve how work gets done through better processes, technology, and thoughtful applications of AI where they can reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, or increase team effectiveness.

#### **You'll enjoy this role if you are...**

* Deeply interested in how marketing teams plan, execute, measure, and improve their work.
* Energized by bringing clarity and momentum to complex, cross-functional work.
* A systems thinker who can connect strategy, priorities, dependencies, decisions, and execution.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating practical structure where none exists.
* Skilled at facilitating alignment among stakeholders with different goals, incentives, and perspectives.
* A clear and concise communicator who can make complicated issues easy to understand and is comfortable surfacing risks, conflicts, and tradeoffs with senior leaders.
* Pragmatic about process, comfortable challenging assumptions, and focused on helping teams get better work done.
* Someone who understands the realities of marketing work and can connect strategic priorities to the details of campaigns, channels, audiences, creative, content, and measurement.

#### **Your day-to-day is...**

* Leading Marketing's annual, quarterly, and cross-functional planning and portfolio management rhythms, while maintaining visibility into material commitments, major initiatives, dependencies, and tradeoffs.
* Managing the integrated Marketing calendar across campaigns, launches, events, content, and other important milestones.
* Facilitating intake and prioritization for new cross-functional requests, helping teams decide what to commit, sequence, experiment, defer, or decline.
* Preparing and facilitating decision forums, ensuring that decisions, owners, next steps, and tradeoffs are clear.
* Identifying risks, blockers, capacity conflicts, and dependency issues before they create delays, and partnering with Marketing leaders to make clear resource allocation and sequencing decisions.
* Establishing lightweight standards, templates, and operating practices that improve clarity, follow-through, and decision speed without centralizing every decision.
* Connecting department-level priorities to team roadmaps and execution backlogs.
* Partnering with Marketing teams to identify where better processes, technology, and practical AI applications can improve planning, execution, measurement, and team effectiveness—and helping turn the most useful ideas into repeatable ways of working.
* Tracking whether the operating model is improving priority clarity, decision speed, dependency management, and delivery, and communicating progress and areas requiring leadership attention in a clear and actionable way.

#### **You'll be successful in this role if you have...**

* 7-10 years of experience in Marketing, Marketing Operations, Marketing Strategy, Go-to-Market Operations, or a related marketing function.
* A strong understanding of how marketing teams plan, launch, measure, and optimize campaigns across channels, audiences, creative, content, and lifecycle programs.
* Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional programs, including managing timelines, risks, dependencies, competing priorities, and delivery in a fast-moving organization.
* Experience building or improving planning, prioritization, portfolio management, or operating processes.
* Sound judgment about when to create structure, when to simplify, and when to let teams work independently.
* A track record of driving progress without relying on formal authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience working with senior stakeholders.
* The ability to synthesize information from multiple teams and turn it into clear decisions and actions.
* Comfort working across business, creative, technical, analytical, and operational teams.
* A bias toward action, accountability, and continuous improvement.

#### **Bonus if you have...**

* Experience working in a marketplace, healthcare, technology, or other complex multi-sided business.
* Experience supporting AI adoption, workflow automation, or change

**Job Description**
-------------------

The NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) is responsible for ensuring the safe and lawful use of buildings and properties by enforcing the NYC Construction Codes, Energy Code and Zoning Resolution. We facilitate compliant development with integrity, efficiency and professionalism. DOB is committed to becoming a premier municipal building organization, dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for all New Yorkers and making our city safer. We are committed to improving our performance and developing procedures that are streamlined, understandable and transparent. We are seeking a Cyber Technical Intelligence Analyst.
  
  
Cyber Technical Intelligence Analyst will perform critical functions within the Threat Management discipline by consuming and analyzing tactical and technical intel, as well as coordinating between New York City Cyber Command and Office of Technology & Innovation Info Sec.
  
  
Duties and Responsibilities include but not limited to the following:
  
  

* Provide intel support and directly assist or execute investigative efforts or tasks;
* Assist hunt missions to augment detection capabilities to identify threats across DOB’s IT operating environment;
* Responsible for the collection, processing, analysis, and dissemination of tactical intelligence (IOC’s) and products (finished reports)
* Develop, maintain, and execute threat and risk communication processes
* Perform network, system, and kill chain analysis on how malware was introduced and propagated;
* Conduct research for tracking certain code families, campaigns, or actors through technical analysis of data, malicious codes, and infrastructure;
* Employ predictive analytic methods to determine changes in adversary’s capabilities, motivations, and intent, while providing recommendations to reduce risk before exposure to threats occur;
* Characterize and analyze network traffic and server/cloud performance metrics to identify anomalous activity and potential threats;
* Resolve New York City Cyber Command’s Security Operations Center remediation requests
* Provide direct analytic support, threat hunting, detection engineering to the Security Operations Center, including Incident Response and Risk Analysts, to add context to active investigations and threats using intelligence;
* Follow up on incident reports and app scan reports to ensure that proper mitigation is taking place in timely manner;
* Investigate suspicious traffic and identify potential attacks, false positives, and missed detections
* Conduct network monitoring and intrusion detection analysis using various computer network defense tools, such as intrusion detection/prevention systems, firewalls and host-based security systems; review and adjust ACL as needed based on source/destination/port by requirement;
* Conduct log-based and endpoint-based threat detection to detect and protect against threats coming from multiple sources;
* Correlate activity across assets (endpoint, network, apps) and environments (on-premises, cloud) to identify patterns of anomalous or suspicious activity;

jobs.description:
**About Away**
--------------

At Away, we design for the reality of travel so you can embrace the journey in full. Launched in 2016 with one thoughtfully designed carry-on, we now offer luggage, accessories, and travel essentials through ecommerce, our retail stores, and wholesale partners. The magic of travel is mirrored in the work we do to bring Away to life, and we invite you to be part of crafting what’s next.

**Join The Crew**
-----------------

We are hiring an IT & Security Manager to join our IT & Security team. This position reports to the Director, IT & Information Security and takes Away further by serving as a highly trusted technical anchor for the brand. In this role, you’ll be empowered to shape modern, resilient IT and security practices that directly protect our people, safeguard our assets, and enable our global business to scale seamlessly.

**What you’ll do as the IT & Security Manager**
-----------------------------------------------

* You'll own and maintain Okta as our central identity provider and system of record for access (SSO/SCIM, RBAC, and JML) across global entities and retail
* You’ll design and manage automated lifecycle workflows and access reviews via Okta Workflows and Rippling integrations to ensure continuous data integrity
* You'll strengthen authentication with phishing-resistant MFA, privileged access hardening, and device-based conditional access
* You'll own the day-to-day execution of the information security program by driving the end-to-end vulnerability management lifecycle, partnering with our outsourced SOC to lead security incident triage and escalation, enforcing access-linked security awareness training, and tracking operational risk posture against functional benchmarks
* You'll protect data in our collaboration platforms through SaaS backup and restore testing, OAuth and integration governance, retention and legal hold, and tiered DLP
* You'll review new AI and SaaS tools for security and data handling, and keep contractors in a managed virtual desktop environment
* You'll govern our enterprise AI platforms, including seats, access tiers, token and API security, and spend, and lead fleet-wide rollout of AI client apps with the IT Operations Engineer
* You'll run Service Management as a product that Logistics, Retail Ops, and other teams manage themselves, supported by SLAs, metrics, and documentation
* You'll serve as the primary IT partner for People & Culture, Retail Ops, and Logistics, leading site-based IT implementations and cross-functional projects from inception to completion

**Who you are**
---------------

* You have a minimum of 4 years of experience in information security operations, identity & access management, or IT operations with a security mandate, including ownership of an identity provider (Okta or equivalent) across multiple entities or locations; Okta Certified Administrator certification or equivalent is highly preferred, but not required
* You have a proven track record of independently managing identity infrastructure (Okta enterprise-scale) and driving cross-functional technical projects end-to-end with moderate guidance
* You've managed an identity provider (Rippling, Okta, Entra, or similar) and reconciled data across systems with discipline, planning for downstream impact before cutover. You've built automations with Okta Workflows or a comparable tool
* You know data protection tooling (DLP or CASB, SaaS backup, ransomware recovery), have tested a restore, have run vulnerability management and remediation tracking, and can map operational work to a recognized security framework
* You've administered an enterprise AI platform (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT), managing access, usage, and spend, and know endpoint management well enough to partner on fleet-wide deployments
* You've administered a service-management platform (Jira Service Management or equivalent), including permissions, workflows, and multi-team rollout
* You're comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-departmental projects from scoping through close-out with minimal oversight
* You communicate clearly in writing; this role produces documentation other non-technical teams rely on directly
* You’re creative and innovative; you love to build great new things that are fresh and unique while staying on brand
* You’re agile, and motivated by a fast-paced and ever changing environment
* You’re passionate about transforming travel for all (but that’s a given!)

*Excited to join the team, but not sure you meet all of the qualifications? Please apply, we’d still love to hear from you.*

--------------

* **We’re travelers.** Travel is about the journey - the transformative experiences and the growth each trip offers. All employees are encouraged to take time to *get away* through our variety of time away from work offerings.
* **We’re driven.** The work we do matters and collectively drives impact. No matter the job title, everyone at Away is a meaningful contributor in unlocking our ever growing potential.
* **We’re supportive.** We value the entirety of your life's journey, not just the milestones. You'll find an environment that celebrates balance, understanding that your personal passions and commitments outside of work, are threads of the same fabric that makes you unique.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

Our total rewards are inclusive of both compensation and benefits. We are looking for a proactive, hands-on Senior Business Intelligence Analyst / BI Developer who loves navigating data and turning it into dashboards that people actually use. Reporting to the Director, Sales Operations, you will own the build-out and quality of our Power BI and Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA) reporting for the WSA USA business.

You are the kind of Senior Analyst who doesn't wait to be asked. You dig into the data, spot what's off or missing, and come back with a fix and a better way of doing it. You are comfortable moving between Salesforce, our ERP and data warehouse, and Excel, and you use AI tools every day to work faster and smarter. If you want to be the go-to person for "what does the data say?" in a growing commercial organization, this role is for you.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**SUMMARY**
===========

The Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst who will be an exceptional addition to our team. You will be responsible for turning data into information, information into insights, and insights into key business decisions that steer the strategic direction of ESPN's direct-to-consumer product strategy. The right person for this role has exceptional analytical capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves problem-solving, is a good communicator, and is passionate about high quality digital product experiences.

You will play a key role in building out ESPN's product analytics function from the ground up, serving as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for the ESPN product and product engineering teams. You will lead the foundational work streams for ESPN app measurement: standing up a governed, centralized source of truth for ESPN app performance metrics — canonical definitions, consistent logic, and numbers the business can align on — and building the self-serve tooling that lets stakeholders not only see that a KPI moved, but locate what drove the movement. You will also be the experimentation partner to the product organization, shaping how ESPN app features are tested and how those results are read.

This role is hands-on and technical. You will design and maintain the aggregation logic and metric tables that sit underneath executive reporting, and you will be expected to defend the numbers you publish — including the measurement caveats that travel with them.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own and evolve the source-of-truth metric layer for ESPN app performance — headline KPIs (DAU, time spent, watch minutes), their definitions, their dimensional breakouts, and the documented caveats that accompany each
* Design and maintain pre-aggregated metric tables and serving views in Snowflake, and the scheduled pipelines that refresh them, ensuring metrics are correct at every level of aggregation
* Build the monitoring and decomposition logic that identifies when a KPI movement is real and where it is concentrated — baselines, significance thresholds, contribution ranking, and volume-versus-mix splits
* Distinguish genuine behavioral movements from measurement artifacts and instrumentation breakage, and partner with product engineering to close the analytics QA gap on client releases
* Build dashboards and self-serve tooling in Looker that reduce stakeholder reliance on ad-hoc analyst pulls
* Conduct analyses using SQL and Python to access and manipulate multivariate product and behavioral data, and ideate new metrics and analytical approaches for in-app user behavior
* Partner with product and engineering on experimentation end-to-end — translating a product question into a testable hypothesis, selecting primary and guardrail metrics, sizing and powering the test, validating assignment and exposure, analyzing the readout, and diagnosing what happened when a test misbehaves or reads flat
* Reconcile ESPN app metrics across teams and systems, and drive alignment on definitions with Research, Data Product, and data engineering partners
* Serve as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for ESPN product and product engineering teams, taking projects end-to-end from vague business need to socialized insight
* Communicate results through compelling data storytelling to product leadership and the broader ESPN business

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Degree in an analytical area such as Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of relevant work experience in analytics, product analytics, and/or business intelligence
* Advanced SQL — able to read and write complex analytical queries, and to reason about correctness of aggregation logic (for example, why a distinct-count metric cannot be summed across segments)
* Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, and pipeline work
* Practical understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling — how metric tables are structured, refreshed, and served to downstream consumers
* Applied statistical judgment: constructing baselines, assessing whether a change is meaningful versus noise, and handling seasonality and day-of-week effects
* Hands-on product experimentation experience — designing and executing A/B and multivariate tests, analyzing results (significance, confidence intervals, minimum detectable effect, guardrail metrics), and diagnosing common failure modes such as sample ratio mismatch, assignment or exposure leakage, interaction effects, and novelty decay
* Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or equivalent) coupled with strong storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience taking vague requirements and manipulating them into polished final products
* Strong and effective communication and presentation skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Hands-on experience with digital clickstream or behavioral analytics data (Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, or similar), including its identity and measurement limitations
* Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or comparable large-scale data processing
* Experience establishing metric governance — canonical definitions, reconciliation across teams, and change management on metric logic
* Experience with an experimentation platform (Optimizely, Statsig, Amplitude Experiment, or in-house) and with scaling experimentation practice across product teams
* Familiarity with identity resolution across web, app, and connected TV, and the practical consequences of cookie-based measurement
* Prior experience in Sports or Media/Entertainment

Our cybersecurity operators are experts at assessing and defending mission-critical data and the networks that facilitate their operation.
